title: Dedicated shapes + price model (working sheet)
body:
LAST UPDATED: 2025-03-07 (LB)

Purpose
- Working sheet to map Dedicated tiers -> standardized shapes -> expected performance -> list pricing + discount guardrails.
- Used by: Product Dedicated + Finance/FP&A + Infra/Fleet + Sales Enablement.
- Not contract language. Performance numbers are sizing estimates; SLO measurement details live in the SLO doc/ADR.

Key reminders / caveats
- All throughput numbers below are EXPECTED sustained throughput under Redwood’s recommended config and steady-state load.
- Variance drivers: model/version, quant profile, context distribution, streaming vs non-streaming, safety filters, tool calling, caching hit rate, request concurrency.
- For SLO: we measure per-deployment, tokens/sec (generated tokens) over a rolling window; exclusions apply (customer-side throttling, unsupported configs, etc.).

============================================================
TAB: Shapes catalog (v0.9)
============================================================
Legend
- Shape ID is what Infra uses internally; Sales-facing packaging can use “S / M / L / XL” names.
- “Max ctx rec” is a recommendation for stable throughput (not a hard limit).
- “Warm pool” indicates whether we keep spare capacity to reduce recovery time / improve burst.

| Shape ID           | Sales name | Default tier | Regions (initial)                 | GPU type | GPU count | GPU mem | CPU / RAM (host)    | Local NVMe | Net (min) | Max ctx rec | Notes |
|-------------------|------------|--------------|-----------------------------------|----------|----------:|--------:|---------------------|-----------:|----------:|------------:|------|
| rdwd-l40s-4       | S          | Standard     | us-east-1, us-west-2              | L40S     | 4         | 48GB    | 64 vCPU / 512GB     | 7.7TB      | 100Gbps   | 8k          | Best for 7B–13B, embeddings, rerank; cost-optimized. |
| rdwd-a100-80-4    | M          | Plus         | us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1| A100     | 4         | 80GB    | 96 vCPU / 768GB     | 7.7TB      | 100Gbps   | 16k         | Strong general-purpose; stable for 30B/34B; some 70B with tight ctx/batching. |
| rdwd-h100-80-4    | L          | Premium      | us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1| H100     | 4         | 80GB    | 96 vCPU / 768GB     | 7.7TB      | 200Gbps   | 16k         | Premium latency + throughput; recommended for 70B, long ctx, higher concurrency. |
| rdwd-h100-80-8    | XL         | Premium      | us-east-1 (limited), us-west-2    | H100     | 8         | 80GB    | 128 vCPU / 1024GB   | 2x7.7TB    | 400Gbps   | 32k         | High-QPS / long ctx; capacity constrained; used for “Premium HA” bundles. |

Operational notes (Infra)
- eu-central-1: A100/H100 supply is variable; treat as “soft availability” until Q2 procurement closes.
- us-east-1: H100-8 lead times fluctuate; offer H100-4 + burst pool as fallback for most deals.
- Dedicated deployments pin to a shape class; upgrades/downgrades require reprovision + validation benchmark.

============================================================
TAB: Performance assumptions (for estimates in this sheet)
============================================================
Baseline workload profiles used to generate tokens/sec estimates (not SLO language)

Profile A (chat-default)
- Prompt tokens: 750
- Generated tokens: 250
- Context mix: p50 2k / p95 8k
- Concurrency: enough to saturate (no client think time)
- Streaming: ON
- Quant: FP16 for 7B–13B; FP16 or INT8 for 30B–70B depending on model support

Profile B (long-context)
- Prompt tokens: 4,000
- Generated tokens: 500
- Context mix: p50 8k / p95 16k
- Streaming: ON
- Emphasis: stable prefill + decode under longer ctx

Profile C (embeddings)
- Input tokens: 512 avg
- Batch: optimized for throughput; latency target p95 < 250ms in-region

How to read throughput
- “Decode TPS” is generated tokens/sec under steady-state.
- “Effective TPS” includes typical prefill overhead and is closer to what customers feel at the deployment level.
- Estimates assume Redwood runtime optimizations (continuous batching, KV cache management) and default safety filters.

============================================================
TAB: Expected throughput (tokens/sec) by shape + model class
============================================================
Model class buckets (rough)
- Small: 7B–8B
- Medium: 13B–15B
- Large: 30B–34B
- XL: 70B (dense)
- NOTE: MoE models can deviate materially; handle as custom sizing.

PROFILE A (chat-default) — Expected sustained throughput per deployment

| Shape        | 7B–8B (eff TPS) | 13B–15B (eff TPS) | 30B–34B (eff TPS) | 70B (eff TPS) | Notes |
|-------------|-----------------:|------------------:|------------------:|--------------:|------|
| L40S-4 (S)  | 9,000–12,000     | 4,500–6,500       | 1,600–2,400       | N/A           | 70B not supported on this shape for SLO-backed commitments. |
| A100-4 (M)  | 11,000–14,000    | 6,000–8,000       | 2,600–3,600       | 900–1,300     | 70B supported with ctx <= 8k recommended; longer ctx reduces floor. |
| H100-4 (L)  | 15,000–20,000    | 8,000–11,000      | 3,800–5,200       | 1,600–2,300   | Best “single deployment” choice for 70B with mixed ctx. |
| H100-8 (XL) | 28,000–36,000    | 14,000–18,000     | 7,000–9,500       | 3,200–4,600   | For very high QPS or multi-route deployments; supply constrained. |

PROFILE B (long-context) — Expected sustained throughput per deployment

| Shape        | 13B–15B (eff TPS) | 30B–34B (eff TPS) | 70B (eff TPS) | Notes |
|-------------|------------------:|------------------:|--------------:|------|
| L40S-4 (S)  | 2,800–4,000       | 1,000–1,500       | N/A           | Long ctx on Standard tier often pushes customers toward Plus. |
| A100-4 (M)  | 3,800–5,200       | 1,600–2,300       | 550–850       | Treat 70B long ctx as “tight” unless batching profile is controlled. |
| H100-4 (L)  | 5,500–7,200       | 2,600–3,600       | 950–1,500     | Premium tier default for long-context 70B. |
| H100-8 (XL) | 10,000–13,000     | 4,800–6,600       | 1,900–2,800   | Recommended when customers require both long ctx + high concurrency. |

Embeddings / rerank sanity (PROFILE C)

| Shape        | Embeddings (req/sec, 512 tok avg) | Rerank (pairs/sec, short) | Notes |
|-------------|-----------------------------------:|---------------------------:|------|
| L40S-4 (S)  | 220–320                            | 140–220                    | Great fit for embedding-heavy Dedicated if latency tolerates batching. |
| A100-4 (M)  | 300–420                            | 190–280                    | Higher concurrency headroom than L40S. |
| H100-4 (L)  | 420–620                            | 260–380                    | Premium latency + high throughput. |

SLO floor placeholder mapping (DO NOT COPY TO CUSTOMER DOCS)
- Working heuristic for packaging: commit a floor ~65% of the low end of “Profile A eff TPS” for the declared model class, after applying tier headroom policy.
- Example: H100-4 on 70B: low end 1,600 eff TPS => floor candidate ~1,040 TPS (pre-headroom); final numbers set in tier definition doc.

============================================================
TAB: Pricing proposal (list) + discount guardrails (v1 working)
============================================================
Pricing objectives
- Preserve predictable unit economics across regions and supply conditions.
- Standard shapes should be “easy to quote” (no custom GPU mixes).
- Discounts constrained to protect GM; larger concessions require Deal Desk + Finance approval.

List pricing (USD/month) — includes Dedicated control plane + standard telemetry retention

| Tier      | Shape(s) included           | Sales name | List price / mo | Included burst policy (packaging assumption) | Notes |
|----------|------------------------------|-----------:|----------------:|---------------------------------------------|------|
| Standard | rdwd-l40s-4                  | S          | 18,000          | Burst up to +20% for up to 2 hrs/day (best-effort) | Default for 7B/13B and embedding-heavy workloads. |
| Plus     | rdwd-a100-80-4               | M          | 32,000          | Burst up to +30% for up to 4 hrs/day (best-effort) | Default for mixed workloads / moderate long-context. |
| Premium  | rdwd-h100-80-4               | L          | 52,000          | Burst up to +40% for up to 6 hrs/day (priority) | Default for 70B or strict latency/consistency. |
| Premium+ | rdwd-h100-80-8               | XL         | 98,000          | Burst +40% (priority) + warm spare capacity | Used for HA-style packages and very high QPS. |

Discount guardrails (proposal)
- Standard: max 15% discount without Deal Desk; floor requires Finance sign-off.
- Plus: max 20% discount without Deal Desk; >25% requires VP Sales + Finance.
- Premium/Premium+: max 25% discount without Deal Desk; >30% requires CFO delegate.
- Multi-region deployments: price is per-region deployment; do not “average” across regions without Finance.

Optional add-ons (placeholders; being standardized elsewhere)
- Extended log retention (90d / 180d): +$1.5k / +$3k per deployment per month
- Compliance pack (SOC2 evidence exports + audit log retention): +$2k per deployment per month
- Premium support upgrade for Standard/Plus: +$4k per deployment per month

============================================================
TAB: Unit economics quick pass (Finance working model excerpt)
============================================================
Assumptions (blended internal COGS; directional)
- L40S blended cost: $1.25/GPU-hr
- A100 80GB blended cost: $2.60/GPU-hr
- H100 80GB blended cost: $3.80/GPU-hr
- Adders: +12% infra overhead (network/storage/ops), +8% spares/maintenance, +support allocation (tiered)
- Target utilization (net of headroom policy): 55% Standard, 50% Plus, 45% Premium (more headroom)

COGS rough math (illustrative)
- Hours/mo assumed: 720

| Shape        | GPU COGS / mo | Overhead adders (20%) | Est. all-in COGS / mo | List price / mo | Est. GM at list |
|-------------|--------------:|----------------------:|----------------------:|----------------:|----------------:|
| L40S-4      | 4 * 1.25 * 720 = 3,600  | 720   | ~4,320  | 18,000 | ~76% |
| A100-4      | 4 * 2.60 * 720 = 7,488  | 1,498 | ~8,986  | 32,000 | ~72% |
| H100-4      | 4 * 3.80 * 720 = 10,944 | 2,189 | ~13,133 | 52,000 | ~75% |
| H100-8      | 8 * 3.80 * 720 = 21,888 | 4,378 | ~26,266 | 98,000 | ~73% |

Interpretation
- At face value, these shapes look very healthy at list; actual realized GM is reduced by:
  - Headroom reserve (warm pool/spares beyond baseline)
  - Burst pool provisioning (esp Premium)
  - Regional price variance + supply-driven premiums
  - Support and incident cost allocation during early rollout
- Finance note (LB paraphrase): we should validate that “effective GM” (after headroom + burst reserve) stays above targets at typical discounts.

Sensitivity (quick)

| Scenario                               | Impact (qualitative) |
|----------------------------------------|----------------------|
| Premium tier requires +15% extra spares | -5 to -9 GM points depending on region |
| Average realized discount +20%          | -12 to -15 GM points |
| Utilization below targets by 10 pts     | -6 to -10 GM points |
| H100 supply premium +$0.60/GPU-hr       | -4 to -6 GM points |

============================================================
TAB: Scenario tables (quoting + sizing examples)
============================================================
Scenario 1: Customer wants 70B, steady 1,200 eff TPS (Profile A-ish), p95 ctx 8k
- Candidate: H100-4
- Expected: 1,600–2,300 eff TPS (estimate)
- Packaging: Premium tier; SLO floor can cover 1,200 target with headroom.
- Quote: $52k/mo list; standard discount guardrails apply.

Scenario 2: Customer wants 13B, long-context heavy (p95 16k), target 4,000 eff TPS
- Candidate: H100-4 OR A100-4 with careful batching/ctx constraints
- Expected on A100-4 (Profile B): 3,800–5,200 eff TPS (borderline; risk if ctx skew higher)
- Recommendation: Plus for cost sensitivity; Premium if they require a stronger floor and less tuning.

Scenario 3: Embeddings-heavy workload, cost sensitive, 250 req/sec target
- Candidate: L40S-4
- Expected: 220–320 req/sec (512 tok avg)
- Note: Ensure customer accepts batching; confirm latency SLA expectations.

============================================================
Open questions / TODO
============================================================
1) Confirm which model classes are SLO-backed per tier (esp 70B on A100-4 under Plus).
2) Define explicit “declared workload profile” inputs required at order form time (model, max ctx, streaming, tool-calling usage).
3) Decide whether Premium+ (H100-8) is a public tier or “Sales assisted only”.
4) Align burst definition with metering (ENG-19302) so invoices can separate committed vs burst consumption.
5) Region-based price multipliers (EU) — Finance to propose, Product to sign off.

Change log
- 2025-02-18: initial table seeded from workshop notes (LB)
- 2025-02-27: added long-context profile + preliminary GM table (LB/LBennett)
- 2025-03-07: updated H100-8 availability notes; tightened discount guardrails language (LB/RMalhotra)
